figures.caption: Therapeutic efficacy of LP-80 in chronic SHIV infection.Five Chinese rhesus monkeys (K1 to K5) were chronically infected with SHIVSF162P3 over 6 months, and were subcutaneously treated with LP-80 for two rounds.
